text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick company update: were publishing two policy clarifications today  Extended Bereavement Guidance and a Travel Policy refresh for company-funded visits. Summary + links below.

Lina (People Ops): TL;DR: bereavement now includes up to 10 days paid for immediate family death (tiered by relation), plus a 5-day discretionary compassionate leave managers can grant. Travel policy: new preapproval windows and a short Travel Conduct acknowledgement for company-funded customer visits.

Jorge (Eng): For the bereavement days, does relocation for a funeral count as paid travel time?

Sam (People Ops): Yes  approved bereavement days include reasonable travel time when you must travel to attend services or handle estate matters. Submit the travel dates on the bereavement form and payroll will align payout.

Omar (Payroll): Process note: bereavement pay posts as paid leave. If youre out >10 days, you can request the discretionary compassionate top-up which will be handled case-by-case. We can also advance pay if needed; put "pay-advance" in the form.

Mei (Security): Travel policy change: any company-funded customer visit to a region flagged as "Heightened" by Security requires the Travel Conduct acknowledgement and the Travel Safety QuickForm. We'll auto-flag bookings; Security will review flagged trips within 24 hours.

Lina (People Ops): New: weve added an Emergency Travel Concierge option for qualifying bereavement/compassionate cases  they can help book flights, contact embassies, or arrange expedited docs. Concierge available by request on the form.

legal-bot: Reminder: legal review required for travel involving minors or cross-border custody matters. Tag "legal-review" in the form to route.

Jorge (Eng): Is the Travel Conduct ack the same as the offsite CoC we had before?

Sam (People Ops): Similar but targeted: the Travel Conduct ack focuses on interactions during customer visits (confidentiality, respectful behavior, expense conduct). It must be completed during travel preapproval for company-funded customer visits. Personal travel unaffected.

Omar (Payroll): Expense policy tweak: per-diem caps updated for region groups A/B/C (see doc). Meal receipts still required over $75 per person for client meals. Per-diem auto-apply will be available in the travel tool later this quarter.

Lina (People Ops): Were also piloting a Temporary Pet Care Stipend ($250 one-time) for employees who must relocate suddenly for a family emergency and need short-term boarding. Eligibility and form fields are in the doc.

peopleops-bot: Notice scheduled: "Travel Conduct ack due" will ping company-funded visitors 7 days and 48 hours before travel departure.

Sam (People Ops): Well host a 30-minute AMA tomorrow 10:30am PT in #people-ops-ama to walk through bereavement tiers, concierge requests, and travel preapproval exceptions. If this is a sensitive situation, DM People Ops or use #people-ops-confidential and well expedite review.

Jorge (Eng): Appreciate this. One last q: who approves the compassionate top-up?

Lina (People Ops): Manager + People Ops sign-off; Legal or Security may be involved for cross-border cases. Thanks everyone  links and full FAQ: https://docs.redwood/internal/bereavement-travel-refresh
